products.description: Products in the order they appear on the site.

id.description: Short unique code: lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. lavender-handsoap. Reviews use this to point to the product. Don't change it once customers have ordered or reviewed it.

category.description: Small label on the product photo, e.g. Dishwashing, Handsoap, Fabric Conditioner

size.description: Size shown on the badge, e.g. 3.8 L or 1 L

unit.description: What the price is per, e.g. gallon, bottle, pack

price.description: Price in pesos, numbers only, e.g. 140

image.description: Photo file in public/images, e.g. images/lavender.webp. A bottle on a transparent background looks best.

color.description: Product color as a hex code, e.g. #9b7fd1. Used for the scent dot and the photo background.

features.description: Short selling points with check marks, 1 to 6

inStock.description: Optional. Set to false to show 'Out of stock' and stop orders for this product.
